1.text: Hariho umuntu wo mu Bafarisayo witwaga Nikodemo, umutware wo mu Bayuda.

2.text: Uwo yasanze Yesu nijoro aramubwira ati “Mwigisha, tuzi yuko uri umwigisha wavuye ku Mana, kuko ari nta wubasha gukora ibimenyetso ujya ukora, keretse Imana iri kumwe na we.”

3.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndakubwira yuko umuntu utabyawe ubwa kabiri, atabasha kubona ubwami bw'Imana.”

4.text: Nikodemo aramubaza ati “Mbese umuntu yabasha ate kubyarwa akuze? Yakongera agasubira mu nda ya nyina akabyarwa?”

5.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndakubwira yuko umuntu utabyawe n'amazi n'Umwuka atabasha kwinjira mu bwami bw'Imana.

6.text: Ikibyarwa n'umubiri na cyo ni umubiri, n'ikibyarwa n'Umwuka na cyo ni umwuka.

7.text: Witangazwa n'uko nkubwiye yuko bibakwiriye kubyarwa ubwa kabiri.

8.text: Umuyaga uhuha aho ushaka, ukumva guhuha kwawo ariko ntumenya aho uva cyangwa aho ujya. Ni ko uwabyawe n'Umwuka wese amera.”

10.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ukaba uri umwigisha w'Abisirayeli ntumenye ibyo!

11.text: Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndakubwira yuko tuvuga ibyo tuzi kandi duhamya ibyo twabonye, nyamara ntimwemera ibyo duhamya.

12.text: Ubwo nababwiye iby'isi ntimwemere, nimbabwira iby'ijuru muzemera mute?

13.text: Ntawazamutse ngo ajye mu ijuru, keretse Umwana w'umuntu wavuye mu ijuru, akamanuka akaza hasi.

14.text: “Kandi nk'uko Mose yamanitse inzoka mu butayu, ni ko Umwana w'umuntu akwiriye kumanikwa,

15.text: kugira ngo umwizera wese abone guhabwa ubugingo buhoraho.”

16.text: Kuko Imana yakunze abari mu isi cyane, byatumye itanga Umwana wayo w'ikinege kugira ngo umwizera wese atarimbuka, ahubwo ahabwe ubugingo buhoraho.

17.text: Kuko Imana itatumye Umwana wayo mu isi gucira abari mu isi ho iteka, ahubwo yabikoreye kugira ngo abari mu isi bakizwe na we.

18.text: Umwizera ntacirwaho iteka, utamwizera amaze kuricirwaho kuko atizeye izina ry'Umwana w'Imana w'ikinege.

19.text: Uko gucirwaho iteka ni uku: ni uko umucyo waje mu isi, abantu bagakunda umwijima kuwurutisha umucyo babitewe n'uko ibyo bakora ari bibi,

20.text: kuko umuntu wese ukora ibibi yanga umucyo, kandi ntaza mu mucyo ngo ibyo akora bitamenyekana,

21.text: ariko ukora iby'ukuri ni we uza mu mucyo, ngo ibyo akora bigaragare ko byakorewe mu Mana.

22.text: Hanyuma y'ibyo Yesu ajyana n'abigishwa be mu gihugu cy'i Yudaya, atindanayo na bo abatiza abantu.

23.text: Ariko Yohana we yabatirizaga muri Ayinoni bugufi bw'i Salimu, kuko aho hari amazi menshi. Abantu barazaga bakabatizwa,

24.text: kuko Yohana yari atarashyirwa mu nzu y'imbohe.

25.text: Abigishwa ba Yohana bajya impaka n'Umuyuda ku byo kwiyeza.

26.text: Basanga Yohana baramubwira bati “Mwigisha, uwari kumwe nawe hakurya ya Yorodani, uwo wahamyaga dore na we arabatiza, n'abantu bose baramusanga.”

27.text: Yohana arabasubiza ati “Nta cyo umuntu yashobora kwiha ubwe, keretse yagihawe kivuye mu ijuru.

28.text: Namwe murambere abagabo yuko navuze nti ‘Si jye Kristo, ahubwo natumwe kumubanziriza.’

29.text: Uwo umugeni asanga ni we mukwe, kandi umuranga iyo ahagaze iruhande rw'umukwe amwumva anezezwa n'ijwi rye. None uwo munezero wanjye mwinshi cyane urasohoye.

30.text: Uwo akwiriye gukuzwa, naho jye nkwiriye kwicisha bugufi.”

31.text: Uwavuye mu ijuru ni we usumba byose, naho uwo mu isi we ni uw'isi nyine, kandi n'ibyo avuga ni iby'isi. Uwavuye mu ijuru ni we usumba byose,

32.text: kandi ibyo yabonye n'ibyo yumvise ni byo ahamya, nyamara nta wemera ibyo ahamya.

33.text: Uwemera ibyo ahamya, aba yemeye n'uko n'Imana ari inyakuri.

34.text: Uwatumwe n'Imana avuga amagambo yayo, kuko Imana idatanga Umwuka imugeze.

35.text: Se akunda Umwana we kandi yamweguriye byose,

36.text: uwizera uwo Mwana aba abonye ubugingo buhoraho, ariko utumvira uwo Mwana ntazabona ubugingo, ahubwo umujinya w'Imana uguma kuri we.
